about: Which milieu types of the city's centre milieu typing (WFS GIS:Turun_keskustan_miljootyypitys, field Tyyppi; the register fact `milieu` of every building, coarse.milieus) count as the town: the centre's streets of town blocks and the old wooden quarters people have moved back into. Rules whose evidence was photographed there apply there only (coarse.milieus.in_town); a building outside every milieu zone is not in the town. The set is W2's (w2-buildings, 2026-11-13, local/loop-integration town-milieus.json), each with its reason; for Jonni to confirm or change. Changing this file is the whole change: move a type between the two lists.

town.Liikekeskusta: business centre: shops, cafes and offices in the ground storeys of the grid (Kauppiaskatu 6, Aurakatu 1)
town.Historiallinen Turku: historic Turku by the river and the cathedral: old town houses with restaurants (Sergio's, Läntinen Rantakatu 27)
town.Avokorttelimiljöö: open blocks of the centre grid: old town houses among later blocks (Linnankatu 29)
town.Mäkipuistomiljöö: the centre's hill quarters round the parks: old stone and wooden blocks (Puutarhakatu 9a)
town.Puukaupunkimiljöö: wooden town: the old wooden quarters, renovated and lived in, with corner shops and cafes (Puutarhakatu 42a)

not_town.Julkisten rakennusten miljöö: public buildings: schools, hospitals, churches; their own types
not_town.Jälleenrakennuskauden kerrostalomiljöö: post-war blocks of flats: few shops
not_town.Muuttuva kaupunkiympäristö: changing districts, former harbour and industry
not_town.Saapumisen miljöö: arrival routes and the harbour: halls and stations
